sampling: 22 body blocks (blank-line paragraphs incl. the results table and References line; headings, images, display math excluded). Took blocks 1,4,7,10,13,16,19,22 then wrapped to 2,5,8,11,14,17,20 (L17,L27,L38,L49,L59,L70,L78,L87,L21,L31,L40,L53,L61-68,L72,L80); 15 claims drawn from them (L68 counted with the table block).

score_evidence.A: Fixed five-section arc TL;DR -> 연구 배경 -> 제안 방법 -> 구현 방식 -> 실험 결과 -> 의의와 한계; no body H1, no skipped levels; math only as $$; Liquid inside math wrapped in {% raw %} (L42). Front matter has subtitle, paper_author, paper_doi, two-level categories, use_math. Nits: L42-43 'max' instead of \max; headings are topic names, not claim headings.
score_evidence.B: '입니다' register holds, table cells are noun phrases. Awkward: L82 '이 글은 이 결과에서 ... 경로일 수 있다고 봅니다' (-> '큰 모델을 하나 더 키우기보다 작은 지휘자를 학습시키는 쪽이 비용 대비 효율이 좋을 수 있습니다'); L82 '미학습 도구' (-> '학습 때 보지 못한 도구'); L59 first and third sentences say the same ('아래 표는 ... 나란히 놓았습니다'); L31 '연구 배경에서 본 호출 쏠림 때문에 보상 설계가 학습의 핵심입니다' is a non-sequitur. '언어모델' spacing (L17, L31).
score_evidence.C: Back-references resolve (L74 -> L40-45, L78 -> L27). Deductions: L78 calls the L27 example '앞서 본 가상의 HLE 질문' though L27 never labelled it hypothetical; L82 '기본 도구 구성에서 낸 점수' collides with '기본 도구' = basic tools in the table (L64, L66), so a reader cannot tell which configuration is meant (it is the main Table 1/16 tool set).
score_evidence.D: Hard part (two normalizations of M) gets help where it appears: sign intuition for min-max on negative costs (L38) and a labelled hypothetical 30/10=3 ratio (L45), plus the train-vs-eval distinction. Deductions: HLE, FRAMES and τ²-Bench are never introduced (first use L27, L17); GRPO, the training algorithm, is never named.
score_evidence.E: Two figures placed where discussed and described, two display equations, one table copied cell-for-cell from the τ²-Bench cost table. Deduction: the only table covers τ²-Bench alone while the HLE/FRAMES headline numbers (L70), preference results (L74) and generalization results (L80) sit in prose; one three-benchmark table would carry them. The table's row selection omits the strongest prompted orchestrators (Claude Opus 4.1 76.8, Qwen3-235B-A22B 75.6).
score_evidence.F: All sampled numbers match Table 1, 2, 3, 15 and 16. Deductions: L27 describes the pilot as choosing among '웹 검색, 코드 실행기, GPT-5-mini, GPT-5' right after the pilot figure; the pilot's tools were GPT-5, GPT-5-mini, Qwen3-32B and Qwen2.5-Coder-32B (Appendix A), and the example is not marked hypothetical there. L82 '적어도 τ²-Bench에서는 미학습 도구 구성일 때 점수가 기본 구성보다 낮아집니다' implies the drop is τ²-specific, but HLE falls more (37.1 -> 22.0) than τ²-Bench (80.2 -> 48.8) relatively, and the unseen set also drops GPT-5 from the toolset, so the comparison is not like-for-like.

claim_headings.evidence: Headings are topic names: '연구 배경' L19, '제안 방법' L29, '구현 방식' L47, '실험 결과' L57, '의의와 한계' L76 (summary's fixed five sections).

running_example.evidence: An HLE question with cheap/expensive tool choices (L27) returns at L78; the method and results sections do not use it; L53 adds a separate movie-booking example.

mechanism_order.evidence: Reward: problem (L31) -> formula (L35-38) -> normalization (L42-45) -> worked 30/10=3 example (L45). No comparison with alternative reward designs; synthesis and filtering have no worked example with numbers.

facts_once.evidence: 80.2/10.3/8.6 appears in TL;DR (L17) and table (L63) only; L59 restates itself within the paragraph.

numbers_scoped.evidence: Scopes are given (τ²-Bench, HLE text-only subset L70), but units are missing in L17 ('비용 10.3, 지연 8.6') and L80 ('비용 34.8과 지연 8.2'); only the table header gives 센트/분. Description L9 keeps '8B' rather than 80억.

nothing_invented.evidence: L27 tool list not from the pilot and unlabelled; L53 '취소·환불 도구' is the writer's example, unlabelled. L45 example is correctly labelled '가상의 경우로'.

writer_assessment.evidence: L82 gives an own judgement ('작은 지휘자를 학습시키는 쪽이 ...'), but its τ²-only generalization caveat is mis-scoped, and the paragraph ends by restating the paper's future work (recursive orchestrators).

length_fit.evidence: About 5 minutes; method gets the most space as fits a method paper.

type_shape.evidence: TL;DR plain prose (L17), five sections, one distilled results table (L61-66), a limitation (L82).

korean_style.evidence: Varied sentence shapes and consistent register; a few awkward sentences (L31, L59, L82) listed under B.

top_issues: L82 limitation is mis-scoped: it says the unseen-tool drop shows 'at least on τ²-Bench', but HLE drops as much (37.1 -> 22.0), the unseen set lacks GPT-5, and all baselines drop too.

L27 describes the pilot as choosing among web search, a code executor, GPT-5-mini and GPT-5. The pilot's tools were GPT-5, GPT-5-mini, Qwen3-32B and Qwen2.5-Coder-32B, and the example is labelled hypothetical only later (L78).

Implementation is thin and results are scattered: GRPO, the training setup and tool/pricing randomization are absent; HLE/FRAMES/τ²-Bench are never introduced; the single table is τ²-only while the HLE/FRAMES, preference and generalization numbers sit in prose; L11 still carries three off-paper tags plus 'Reasoning-Models'.
